description: DNS lookup for up to 12 domains in ONE paid call: A, AAAA, MX and NS by default (or the types you ask for), NXDOMAIN status, DNSSEC validation and SPF/verification hints per name, plus a summary of which names resolve, which are NXDOMAIN and which have MX. Resolved via DNS-over-HTTPS. names x types must be <= 48. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).

types.description: optional comma list of A,AAAA,CNAME,MX,TXT,NS,CAA,SOA (default A,AAAA,MX,NS)

name: domain_dns_batch
